items.title: Russian deputy prime minister visits Afghanistan for trade talks
items.summary: Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexey Overchuk arrived in Afghanistan leading a Russian delegation. He said the Taliban authorities were interested in purchasing Russian vehicles, energy supplies, food, grain and fertilizers.

items.title: Poland reportedly tests drone integration in mechanized infantry
items.summary: Reports describe Polish military exercises evaluating a pilot project to integrate unmanned systems into a mechanized infantry battalion, reflecting the growing importance of drones and counter-drone capabilities in modern warfare.
